proposals.rationale: I changed one harness page and nothing else: `plugins/core/skills/crew/references/writing.md`, a new paragraph at the end of "Facts are kept". The `contest-with-evidence` grader of `spec-resolve-rules` judges the final message and wants finding 1 contested with `src/accounts.mjs` and its Map named as the evidence; it failed all three votes in one run while the other five dispositions passed, so the miss is on the evidence a contest carries, not on the rules the session read. The page that governs that step, `wizardingcode-spec-resolve/SKILL.md`, is outside the folders I may edit, and I confirmed from the bundled engine that a session with no item open gets nothing from the prompt hook and only one pointer into my folders from the session-start hook: the line that every text, the ending included, follows the writing page. That page said a file and line is attribution but never that a claim about the code is cited by the file and the symbol, read before it is cited, nor that a reviewer's own admission or "this was intentional" is no source. The new paragraph says exactly that with a neutral example, so a resolve session that contests from its memory of the code, or from the reviewer's "in fact it does hold them in a Map", is told to open the file and name the symbol in its answer. Every pinned string and heading of the page is intact, and I ran nothing: no tests, no eval rerun. If the failing run instead proposed a fix for finding 1, this edit does not reach it, since the disposition rules live on the resolve page I may not touch.
